subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I could sense the __________ between husband and wife.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. 'disharmony'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disharmony (अनैक्य) **- Lack of harmony or agreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The **disharmony **within the team affected their performance in the match.
 
 
 
• From the example it is clear that the given sentence means that the speaker could detect or feel the tension, disagreement, or conflict between the husband and wife.
 
• Hence, 'Disharmony' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the complete sentence is *I could sense the disharmony__ between husband and wife.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jangling (खनकना)** - Making a metallic ringing sound.

 
 
• **Example:** The jangling of the keys alerted everyone of his arrival.
 
 
 
• **Raucous (कोलाहलपूर्ण)** - Making a disturbingly loud and harsh noise.
 
 
• **Example: **The kids' rambunctious and raucous laughter filled the house.
 
 
 
• **Tunelessness (बेसुरापन)** - Lack of melody or pleasant musical sound.
 
 
• **Example:** His attempt at singing was marked by an unfortunate amount of tunelessness.
